title: docs(openspec): plan #3372 check every module of a moved prefix
summary: PR #3378 plans the move of the stage modules. Its verify command searches the bare prefix `devops_cli.roadmap.stage`, which matches the old `stage.py` import lines and every path under the new `stage/` package. The negative search passes only when it finds no match, so it can never pass on the tree that the plan produces.

defects.problem: The group gives the verify command `! git grep -n -F devops_cli.roadmap.stage src/ tests/`. The literal matches the import lines of the old `stage.py` and every import path under the new `stage/` package, such as `devops_cli.roadmap.stage.ready`. A negative search passes only when it finds no match, so the command can never pass on the tree that the plan produces.
defects.evidence: The plan creates `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/ready.py` and the other modules of the stage package. The import path of each new module starts with `devops_cli.roadmap.stage`, which is the literal of the negative search. The plan's own spec says the search proves that no top-level module of the prefix stays in place.
defects.message: can never pass on the produced tree
